g.text: Exposes IVolumeRegistry / IVolumeLoader / ILogSink / IDesktopShell as
facade properties. Concrete IVolumeRegistry + IVolumeLoader are built in
Bootstrap (no skeleton class); ILogSink realised by DebugLogging (Tier-3);
IDesktopShell realised by ST6 CanvassDesktop. Boundary value-types
live in Kernel/BoundaryValueTypes.cs and are used by every team.
WorkspaceService is now the single realiser of the four ST7 contracts:
them have been removed. Contracts are also declared exactly once, in
IFitsMaskWriter, IFitsCubeReader). They reproduce ST1/ST2 contract
shape so the ST3/ST5 skeletons compile-as-illustrated; ownership stays
with ST1 / ST2, hence they are drawn inside Kernel / Data above.
Black-box implementation unit (a class or cohesive cluster)
Provided interface (realised by the attached component)
Required interface / dependency (injected at a composition root)
Assembly-scoped interface; cross-team consumers may NOT bind
Unity ACL — touches UnityEngine within its package
Interface DECLARED by one team, REALISED by another
All seven sub-teams are now skeleton-ported (info/README.md). Cross-team
contracts are declared by their owning team and realised wherever the
concrete lives — e.g. IVolumeDataSet is ST1-declared, ST3-realised
SpectralProfileHelper) and the ST3 HistogramMenuController live physically
under UI/ but are owned by ST5 / ST3.
Realisers absent from the skeleton (built at a composition root): concrete
